content:
“Home is where the heart is.”

**Homebody** is an Endurance-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Gain gradual health regeneration while in your camp or workshop.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | While in a C.A.M.P. or Workshop, gain HP & Limb regen. Improves well rested benefits. | 00393F6E |
